newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey sells 290 trln lira 9-mth bills, yield up. [CORRECTED 11:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Turkey sells 290 trln lira 9-mth bills, yield up. [CORRECTED 11:00 GMT]

text.p: The Turkish Treasury met almost all of the bids in Tuesday's nine-month, discount bill auction.
It sold 290.2 trillion lira of 9-month bills at sharply higher yield after selling 75.7 trillion lira of six-month bills at 119.41 percent yield (including witholding tax) last Tuesday.

Banks will pay 155.4 trillion (corrects from 194 trillion) lira for the auction on Wednesday when the Treasury will repay banks 21.3 trillion lira of three-month interest on two-year, inflation indexed coupon bonds it issued on April 1.
